steps.instruction: Select the category that best matches your issue (e.g., 'Something else' > 'Auto-renewal or subscription trap').
Provide details about the company, the subscription, cancellation attempts, and continued charges.
Submit your report. The FTC uses complaints to identify patterns and build enforcement cases.
steps.note: The FTC does not resolve individual complaints but uses them to prioritize enforcement actions. Filing creates an important record.

additional_venues.name: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB)
additional_venues.when_to_use: If the subscription issue involves a financial product (credit card, bank account) or if the company is a financial services provider.
additional_venues.response_note: CFPB forwards complaints to companies and requires a response within 15 days. More likely to result in individual resolution than FTC.

additional_venues.name: Better Business Bureau (BBB)
additional_venues.when_to_use: Supplementary escalation. BBB forwards complaints to companies and many businesses respond to maintain their BBB rating.
additional_venues.response_note: Not a government agency but many companies respond to BBB complaints.

filing_fee.condition: No fee for any of these
